property.name: Libošovice Log Cottage
property.tagline: Libošovice · the heart of Bohemian Paradise
property.headline: A log cottage where time is measured by crackling wood
property.perex: A hundred-year-old log cottage for 8 people, with a sauna, a terrace with a fire pit, and rock towns just beyond the garden.
property.about: The cottage sits at the edge of the village, its back to the forest and its face to the valley. Inside there is a parlour with a wood stove, a large table for the whole party, and four bedrooms in the attic and on the ground floor. Behind the house lies a fenced garden with a fire pit, a sauna and a cold tub.

reservationTerms.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 30 days before arrival

beds.title: 8 beds in 4 bedrooms
beds.description: Two attic bedrooms, two on the ground floor, a cot on request.

sauna.title: Finnish sauna
sauna.description: A heated sauna with a relaxation room and a cold tub in the garden.

kitchen.title: Fully equipped kitchen
kitchen.description: Dishwasher, oven, coffee machine, cast-iron cookware and a wood stove.

terrace.title: Terrace and fire pit
terrace.description: A covered terrace, a grill, a fire pit and 1,200 m² of fenced garden.

pets.title: Pets welcome
pets.description: Dogs are at home here — the garden is fenced all around.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi and quiet
wifi.description: A fast connection when you need one. And silence when you don't.

plakanek.title: Plakánek
plakanek.description: A fairy-tale valley with a brook and old mills — the trail starts at the cottage.

kost.title: Kost Castle
kost.description: One of the best-preserved Gothic castles in Bohemia.

humprecht.title: Humprecht Chateau
humprecht.description: A Baroque summer palace above Sobotka with remarkable acoustics.

prachovskeSkaly.title: Prachov Rocks
prachovskeSkaly.description: The best-known rock town of Bohemian Paradise, with viewpoints.

trosky.title: Trosky
trosky.description: The emblem of Bohemian Paradise — two towers on basalt volcanic plugs.

jicin.title: Jičín
jicin.description: Rumcajs's town: a square, a swimming lake and rainy-day family trips.

checkInOut.question: When are check-in and check-out?
checkInOut.answer: Arrival from 15:00, departure by 10:00. We are happy to agree on another time.

howToBook.question: How does booking work?
howToBook.answer: You send a non-binding enquiry with your dates and the number of guests. Within 24 hours we confirm availability and the exact price. Only then are the dates firmly yours.

cancellation.question: Can I cancel?
cancellation.answer: Free cancellation up to 30 days before arrival. After that the deposit is refunded as agreed.

winter.question: Is the cottage suitable in winter?
winter.answer: Yes. It is insulated, heated by both a wood stove and electric heating, and firewood is included. The cottage is reachable by car in winter too.

pets.question: Can we bring a dog?
pets.answer: You can. The garden is fully fenced. We only ask that the dog does not sleep in the beds.

novakovi.author: The Novák family
novakovi.text: This is our third year coming here. The owners are welcoming, the cottage still looks brand new, and the garden is paradise for the kids.

petr.author: Petr S.
petr.text: We came for a long weekend with friends. The kitchen can cook for eight, and the terrace is beautiful. Warmly recommended.

marketaJan.author: Markéta and Jan
marketaJan.text: A sauna after a whole day hiking up to Trosky is exactly what you need. Quiet, no neighbours.

dvorakovi.author: The Dvořák family
dvorakovi.text: We brought our dog and nobody frowned. The fenced garden matters a lot to us.
